progression.narrative: The performance opens on Ak4 and dwells most on C in Takht-e Taqdis. The line peaks at D5 (569.1 Hz) at 0:24.2. It closes on G4, not the tonic (G4 → F4 → Ak4 → Bb4 → G4 → G4).
